name: Fresh MD2 pineapple
summary: The sweet, golden export pineapple, graded and packed at our CPPC for export and domestic buyers.
description: MD2 is the world's leading export variety: sweet, low-acid and golden through the flesh. Our MD2 comes from our own farms and contract growers, is collected at harvest, then sorted, graded and packed at the CPPC and kept in cold rooms before it leaves by air from KLIA or by sea from Port Klang.
notes: Graded and packed at our CPPC
Air via KLIA, sea via Port Klang
